capabilities.description: Assemble and render an approved media package into a video artifact
Generate or transform video through an approved provider adapter
Generate or transform image assets through an approved provider adapter
Resize, crop, composite, optimize or otherwise process approved images
Generate narration or speech audio through an approved provider/renderer
Mix, normalize, trim or otherwise process approved audio
Generate or transform music through an approved provider adapter
Prepare approved music beds and mixes for rendering
Render subtitles/captions as part of media execution

extension_rule: New video, image, audio, voice, music or media-processing capabilities are registered and implemented inside Mina-Video; the Factory boundary remains provider-neutral.
adoption_rule: A capability must have evidence for usefulness, security, rights/policy compatibility, bounded resource impact, isolation and rollback/containment before production activation.
anti_sprawl_rule: Do not register or retain a capability solely because it is new or free. First identify the concrete gap, existing alternatives and measurable reason to keep it.
security_rule: Registration does not grant credentials, billing, publication authority, governance authority, or permission to bypass Factory policy/rights/approval gates.
